projects.name: 🧬 Block Genomics
projects.description: AI Agent verification protocol using Bitcoin block ownership (Bitmap) + unique genome fingerprints. Each agent/human gets a 64-char hex genome hash derived from their Bitcoin block — this genome drives a unique 3D DNA helix visualization and trust score.
